Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus project. `src/commonMain/kotlin`: shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop`: Linux implementation/C interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}`: tests/fixtures. `codegen/`: JVM XML-to-Kotlin CLI/library; `plugin/`: Gradle plugin `com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin` on `:codegen`; `compile_test/`: compile-time wiring; `samples/bluez-scan/`: example.

Use root Gradle wrapper:
`./gradlew build`; `./gradlew test`; `./gradlew ktlintCheck`; `./gradlew licenseCheck`; `./gradlew dokkaHtml`; `./gradlew codegen:fatJar`.
CI release/docs on Ubuntu: `gradle publish codegen:fatJar`; `gradle dokkaHtml`.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4 spaces, LF, max 100 chars. ktlint `android_studio`; names: classes `UpperCamelCase`, functions/properties `lowerCamelCase`, packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`. Keep public API changes intentional; binary compatibility validation (`apiValidation`). Tests: `src/nativeTest`, `codegen/src/test/kotlin`, `plugin`; descriptive names (e.g. `createsProxyFromXml`). Run `./gradlew test` before PRs; include integration coverage for transport/interop changes.
